prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical medium full-body summer lifestyle image of an adult woman with long wavy blonde hair seated calmly on a beach towel. She wears a light lavender ribbed bikini with thin straps and tie-side bottoms, with one leg bent, the other extended, and one arm placed behind her for support. Set the scene on a sandy beach backed by low rocky cliffs and green coastal plants. Arrange a woven straw tote with pink accents, an open book, and pink beauty items including a compact, brush, and pouch on the towel. Use soft warm daylight, gentle shadows, a clean editorial color palette of lavender, sand beige, soft pink, and green, with a relaxed, non-sexualized swimwear lookbook mood. No text, logo, or watermark.
